title: Change EMT incident response
summary: Change EMT while keeping incident correspondence and Nucleus references small, investigation agent-driven, and product recovery in supported interfaces.
use_when: EMT source, owning documentation or selected prompts must be changed within an established scope.
do_not_use_when: The user needs another recipient, sender authentication, continuous repair, or a replacement for product-owned recovery.
outcome: A scoped EMT source, documentation or prompt change with preserved authority, compatibility and exact recovery identities, plus the explicitly authorized validation endpoint.
effects: Authorized source and documentation changes affect a candidate release; prompt append changes future selected preparation only after a complete selection is published. Live jobs, account reads, messages, installation, activation, publication and CI submission require their own authority.
authority: EMT owns its source, detailed feature explanations, procedures, rendering and selection meaning. Providers own their exported interfaces; affected products own intervention results. User deferral sets the authorized endpoint.
success: Owning feature/procedure declarations align, focused checks pass, compatible acyclic documentation closure is verified and the authorized endpoint is established. A deferred manager gate or deployment is not a passing or installed release.
failure_and_recovery: Preserve exact request and mail identities, historical prompt versions and unrelated work. Inspect Bazaar history after an uncertain append before repeating it. Stop if authority, public compatibility, scope or recovery cannot be established.
privacy: Keep private correspondence, prompt content, credentials and runtime records outside source and logs. Prefer private files for authorized Bazaar content updates.
does_not_authorize: Live jobs, account reads, messages, installation, activation, publication or manager submission beyond the established user scope.
Operation adapters, activity mirrors, structured diagnosis or automatic failed-assignment replacement without a new user requirement.

consumers.statement: An authorized developer changing EMT source, feature contracts, procedures or selected prompt content.

preconditions.statement: Read EMT AGENTS.md, current required features, Cell Semantics when EMT is unregistered, and nucleus manual before shared boundary changes. Establish endpoint and user authority first.

inputs.statement: The agreed change, current public feature/procedure contracts, provider-owned types and clients, private authorized prompt files when applicable, and the explicitly authorized validation/submission endpoint.

outputs.statement: A scoped candidate change, aligned documentation, focused validation evidence and either retained manager outcome or explicit user deferral. Prompt receipts identify appended immutable versions and complete selection content.

data_semantics.statement: Source work does not itself authorize live system effects. A Bazaar append changes no caller selection until a complete selection is published; saved requests retain frozen instructions.

identity_and_units.statement: Preserve stable entry IDs and compatible versions, exact request/mail/halt identities, positive prompt version numbers and the submitted commit identity when submission is authorized.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Review current selected contracts and candidate publication bytes. Focused checks establish their tested candidate boundary; only retained manager outcome establishes the manager job result.
Focused checks do not promise an installed release, live readiness, model accuracy, inbox completeness, timer latency or final-delivery deadline.

access.statement: Repository and private authorized prompt work use current-user filesystem and shell access. Keep private content outside source; user deferral controls commits, manager submission, release and deployment.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Keep behavior in authoritative feature pages, procedure prerequisites and checkpoints in operation manuals, and release bytes matched. Append complete prompt selections after component publication; retain baseline and historical versions for recovery.

operational_limits.statement: Keep incident and exchange domain records, Nucleus references, bounded assignments and exact mail recovery. Do not add adapters, activity mirrors, structured diagnosis or automatic replacement without a new requirement.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Preserve public meaning, provider compatibility, exact identities and historical versions. Validate source bundle, ordinary/full show and complete acyclic resolve before authorized release.
No future support lifetime or retention horizon is promised.

reliances.statement: EMT incident authority and exchange recovery constrain the change.
EMT service readiness, maintenance and publication recovery constrain the change.
Quota deferral and exact condition-mail progress constrain the change.
Bazaar owns authorized append receipts and immutable version retention; EMT owns selection content.

steps: Read product instructions, maintained vocabulary, current required features and the shared playbook.
Establish scope and authorized endpoint; preserve product authority and exact recovery identities.
Update only owning source, feature contracts, procedures and normalized declarations.
For an authorized prompt edit, append component text then the complete pinned selection; verify receipts and preserve history.
Validate focused behavior and isolated source publication; commit and submit only within user-authorized scope.
checkpoints: Current meanings and authority remain compatible.
No private source content or runtime records enter documentation.
Candidate bundle show and resolve are coherent and dependency closure is compatible and acyclic.
The explicitly authorized endpoint is verified; deferred manager/deployment work remains visible.
adaptation: Update owning contracts and the shared Nucleus manual when public boundaries change.
Use the Cell semantic repository until EMT is registered.
stop_when: Authority, scope, public compatibility or recovery cannot be established.
A live effect or manager submission lies beyond the user-authorized endpoint.
